title: 第27章 造反祸事
content_zh:
定远城六扇门点卯早衙时，一众银衣、铜章、铁尺分成了三个阵营。

    首先是权势最大的夏银衣派，就只有夏妙筝和沈千钧两个人。

    然后就是数量最多的地头蛇派了，他们勉强算是中立人员，还在观望。

    最后就是过江龙派了，也就是田牧川他带来的一众铜章捕快。

    人虽然最少，但却是最团结的一派。

    不出意外的话，过些时日就会变成地头蛇派。

    毕竟他们是过来当官的，其目标和地头蛇派一样，无非就是升官发财。

    所以利益上并没有多少冲突。

    一时间，气氛有些剑拔弩张，毕竟这群过江龙派的人都对夏银衣派的沈千钧有敌意。

    若非自己争取，他们此前辛苦拿到的功劳可就归了沈千钧了。

    要不是夏妙筝和田牧川同为银衣捕头，以沈千钧的身份地位，早就被他们想办法处理了。

    “看来，你们相处的还挺和谐的。”定远知府上官疏桐带着人走了进来，脸上带着一丝笑意。

    众人见此，也是起身见礼。

    “好了，别客气，坐。”上官疏桐跟着回礼后，这才说道：“我来这里也是有要事。”

    他看得出来田牧川是误会了自己来为夏妙筝站台的，这才特意解释了一下。

    事实上，他现在完全没有闲心思去管这所谓的‘女儿’了。

    “风闻司的情报，你们看了没有？”上官疏桐又问道。

    “上官大人，我今早才接下公差，还未看。”田牧川直接说道。

    “是那莲香教吗？”夏妙筝当即开口。

    “没错。”上官疏桐点点头说道：“根据线报，莲香教的教徒已经潜入了咱们定远城，似乎是有什么大计划。”

    “只是...”说到这里，上官疏桐却叹了一口气，无奈地说道：“我们安排进去的线人被策反了。”

    一听这话，魏乐府也是有些奇怪，你们给的是什么待遇啊，怎么线人都能被策反。

    他明白上官疏桐的意思，就是目前唯一可以确认的是所谓的莲香教要搞事，其他的一概不知道。

    至于莲香教是什么...魏乐府也不知道，丁守成的记忆里可没有这么一个势力。

    毕竟四方武馆只是个小武馆，松阳县也只是个小地方，信息情报没有那么灵通。
content_en:
When the six gates of Dingyuan City clicked on the morning office, a group of people wearing silver clothes, bronze medals, and iron rulers were divided into three camps.

First of all, the most powerful Xia Yinyi faction consists of only two people, Xia Miaozheng and Shen Qianjun.

Then there are the local snake faction with the largest number. They can barely be regarded as neutrals and are still waiting and watching.

Finally, there is the Guojiang Dragon Sect, which is the group of bronze medal cops brought by Tian Muchuan.

Although there are the fewest people, they are the most united group.

If nothing else happens, they will become local snakes after some time.

After all, they came here to be officials, and their goal was the same as that of the local snake sect, which was nothing more than promotion and wealth.

So there is not much conflict of interest.

For a moment, the atmosphere was tense. After all, these people from the Guojiang Dragon Sect were hostile to Shen Qianjun of the Xia Yinyi Sect.

If they hadn't fought for it themselves, the credit for their previous hard work would have gone to Shen Qianjun.

If Xia Miaozheng and Tian Muchuan hadn't both been arrested in silver, given Shen Qianjun's status, they would have found a way to deal with it.

"It seems that you get along quite harmoniously." Shangguan Shutong, the magistrate of Dingyuan, walked in with a smile on his face.

Seeing this, everyone stood up and bowed.

"Okay, you're welcome, sit down." After Shangguan Shutong returned the greeting, he said, "I have important things to do here."

He could see that Tian Muchuan had misunderstood that he came to support Xia Miaozheng, so he explained specifically.

In fact, he has no time to worry about this so-called 'daughter' now.

"Have you read the information from the Rumor Division?" Shangguan Shutong asked again.

"Sir Shangguan, I just took over the business this morning and haven't seen it yet." Tian Muchuan said directly.

"Is it the Lotus Sect?" Xia Miaozheng said immediately.

"That's right." Shangguan Shutong nodded and said, "According to the tip, the followers of the Lianxiang Sect have sneaked into our Dingyuan City, and they seem to have some big plan."

"It's just..." At this point, Shangguan Shutong sighed and said helplessly: "The informant we arranged to go in was incited to rebel."

Upon hearing this, Wei Yuefu was also a little surprised. What kind of treatment are you giving? Why can informants be incited to rebel?

He understood what Shangguan Shutong meant, which was that the only thing that could be confirmed at the moment was that the so-called Lianxiang Sect was causing trouble, and he didn't know anything else.

As for what the Lianxiang Sect is... Wei Yuefu doesn't know, and there is no such force in Ding Shoucheng's memory.

After all, Sifang Martial Arts Hall is just a small martial arts gym, and Songyang County is only a small place, and the information is not that well-informed.
